section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single study (Study X) conducted in the United Kingdom with N = 646 participants (446 women, 199 men, 1 other). The sample had a mean age of 38.92 years, was predominantly White (92.4%), and had a mean self-reported BMI of 27.25 (26.10 for women, 27.72 for men). Educational qualifications showed that 53.7% had college or higher education (36.7% undergraduate, 15.6% postgraduate, 1.4% in full-time education).
